gloss: to worry needlessly in advance; to borrow trouble

definitions.gloss: to worry needlessly in advance; to borrow trouble
definitions.explanation: To worry about something before it happens, especially when the worry turns out to be unnecessary. Almost always appears in the set expression 取り越し苦労.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧だった⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It was needless worry, wasn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧で、⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}していた→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: My worries about the exam results were needless — I passed just fine.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{越|こ}して⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめよう。
examples.english: Nothing has been decided yet, so let's stop worrying about the future prematurely.

notes:
This verb is most commonly encountered in the compound noun {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ (needless worry; borrowing trouble), which is a very common expression. The standalone verb form is less frequent.

KEY EXPRESSION:
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: needless anxiety; worrying about things that haven't happened yet

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧だった: it was needless worry
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worry needlessly
- {取|と}り{越|こ}して⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧: to worry prematurely
Godan verb (す row). Conjugates: {取|と}り{越|こ}さない, {取|と}り{越|こ}して, {取|と}り{越|こ}します.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{杞憂|きゆう}→杞憂：09328_kiyuu⟧: groundless fears — more literary, from a Chinese story
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧し{過|す}ぎ: worrying too much — more general
